snippet.title: Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Planet of Lana II is coming to Steam, Xbox X/S, Xbox Game Pass, Xbox One, Xbox PC, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on March 5, 2026 - Wishlist Now!
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2997230/Planet_of_Lana_II/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011317
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/planet-of-lana-ii/9pl89b9hcz9w

A playable demo will go live on February 11, giving you a first hands-on look at Lana and Mui’s adventure.

As greed and power divide the tribes of their home planet, Lana and her loyal companion Mui must stand together against the forces reshaping their world - struggling not just for survival, but for the very soul of their home. Embark on an unforgettable cinematic puzzle journey across Novo, where ancient mysteries and new threats will test your wits, challenge Lana’s unbreakable bond with Mui, and guide her toward her destiny.
Prepare to explore an expanded story, tackle challenging new puzzles, and master evolved companion mechanics - all brought to life by breathtaking hand-painted environments and a sweeping orchestral soundtrack. 

You don’t need to have played the first Planet of Lana to enjoy the sequel, but the original game is available if you’d like to explore where their story began.

Follow Planet of Lana on social media to stay up to date!
